aiSummary: In October 2026, Google led search engines (mobile) in Kenya at 99.45% (market share of tracked page views / usage). bing ranked second at 0.24%, followed by DuckDuckGo at 0.14%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engines (mobile) in Kenya?
faqs.answer: Google leads at 99.45% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-market-share/mobile/kenya.

faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.
